name: Chemical Coast
description: Changed coastlines where chemical tides dissolve untreated metal and wrecks rust into the brine.
role: A salvage frontier on Earth, dangerous to equipment and generous to those who know the tides.
ambience: Hissing surf, acrid spray and the groan of hulls settling into the flats.
paletteDirection: Teal-green brine, corroded copper, oil black and pale salt crust.
